first_error_evidence: In the thinking step, the agent initially identified Tuesday Jan 16, 14:00-15:00 as valid but then self-corrected, noting Alice's availability ends at 14:00 and so that slot is invalid.
verification_evidence: Step 7 programmatically checks all candidate time slots across all days, confirming the two valid slots (Wed Jan 17 and Thu Jan 18, both 11:00-12:00); step 9 reads back the generated ICS file to confirm correct content.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent read all three ICS calendar files, used a think step and programmatic slot enumeration to identify the earliest valid 1-hour meeting time satisfying all constraints, then generated and verified the output ICS file.
